(1B) An Order made under subsection (1) shall be
served on the person to whom the Order relates, by
the  Magistrate  in  whose  judicial  division  such
person  resides  and  the  report  of  the  Judicial
Medical Officer referred to in subsection (1A) shall
be  produced  before  the  Magistrate  to  ensure  that
such person has not been subjected to torture before
serving such Order on such person.
(1C)  Where  the  report  issued  by  the  Judicial
Medical Officer under subsection (1A) reveals that
such  person  has  been  subjected  to  torture,  the
Magistrate  shall  make  an  appropriate  order  to
provide necessary medical treatment to such person.
(1D) The Magistrate may also direct the Inspector
General  of  Police  to  commence  an  investigation
into  the  alleged  torture  in  order  to  enable  the
Attorney-General to institute criminal proceedings
against  the  person  who  is  alleged  to  have
committed the torture.”.
